name: Kodo Roundup
summary: At Scrabblescrew's Camp, five tamed kodos are needed for a caravan due soon. You take Smeed Scrabblescrew's kodo kombobulator among Desolace's ancient, aged and dying kodos, then lead each tamed beast back to camp.

sections.title: A Caravan on Its Way
sections.body: A caravan is due at Scrabblescrew's Camp shortly, and Smeed Scrabblescrew says it depends on him. Bibbly thinks no other goblin in Desolace knows how to make a profit. Smeed disagrees. He has formed a partnership with Cork and Rigger, and the caravan is willing to brave this land.

sections.title: The Kodo Kombobulator
sections.body: Smeed built the kodo kombobulator to revive aged and dying kodos and bring them under control. Aim it at an ancient, aged or dying kodo, and the device jolts the beast into a tamed kodo that follows you. Bring five kodos and the device back to Scrabblescrew's Camp.

faq.answer: Smeed Scrabblescrew is at Scrabblescrew's Camp in Desolace. He invented the kodo kombobulator and partnered with Cork and Rigger. Bibbly thinks no other goblin in Desolace knows how to make money, but Smeed disagrees.

faq.q: Why does Smeed need tamed kodos?
faq.answer: Smeed is waiting for five newly tamed kodos. The caravan that depends on him is due at Scrabblescrew's Camp shortly.
Smeed built the kodo kombobulator to revive aged or dying kodos and bring them under control. It jolts a targeted beast into a tamed kodo that follows you.

faq.q: Which kodos can you use the kombobulator on?
faq.answer: You can use the kodo kombobulator on ancient, aged and dying kodos. Once tamed, each kodo follows you back to Scrabblescrew's Camp.
Bibbly is a goblin in Desolace who thinks no other goblin there knows how to make money. Smeed Scrabblescrew disagrees.
